defect: pilots 013 and 014 measured Marriott at 0/2 on the legacy /hotels/travel/ template and 11/11 on /en-us/hotels/. A row still routed to the legacy shape is a stale ROUTE, not an unreachable hotel.
rule: rewrite ONLY when the legacy URL already states the committed property code and the rewrite preserves it. Otherwise leave ROUTING_REPAIR_REQUIRED -- a URL is an identity claim and this order will not compose one.

left_for_repair_rows.why: the routed URL uses the legacy /hotels/travel/ template, which pilots 013 and 014 measured at 0/2, and it cannot be rewritten from the committed property code alone. Left ROUTING_REPAIR_REQUIRED and NOT paid for: buying a known-bad route is buying a failure.
